summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without committing or running tests. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" formatter and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal and returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32 via sys.platform, matching that file's convention), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not run; line lengths were checked by eye only.
